title: Deep learning-based multi-level airway collapse site localization on obstructive sleep apnea patients based on snoring sounds
abstract: arXiv:2408.16030v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Objective This study evaluated deep learning models, specifically ResNet-50 and Audio Spectrogram Transformer (AST), to identify multi-level upper airway collapses in obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) patients using snoring sounds. Methods Snoring recordings from 37 subjects undergoing drug-induced sleep endoscopy (DISE) between 2020 and 2021 were used to train models for two multi-label tasks: identifying obstructions at the Velum (V), Oropharynx (O), Tongue-base (T), and Epiglottis (E) levels, and the retropalatal (RP) vs. retroglossal (RG) levels. Results The AST model significantly outperformed ResNet-50 (P <0.05 after Bonferroni correction), effectively identifying V-, O-, and RP-level obstructions (F1-score: 0.59-0.87, Matthews Correlation Coefficient: 0.50-0.80, and AUC: 0.87-0.97). However, the performance of both models at the T, E, and RG levels remained limited due to small sample sizes, even with the Synthetic Minority

translated_title: 基于鼾声的阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停患者多级别气道塌陷部位定位的深度学习方法
translated_abstract: 目的：本研究评估了深度学习模型，特别是ResNet-50和音频频谱图Transformer（AST），利用鼾声识别阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停（OSA）患者的多级别上气道塌陷。方法：使用2020年至2021年间37名接受药物诱导睡眠内镜检查（DISE）受试者的鼾声记录来训练模型，完成两项多标签任务：识别软腭（V）、口咽（O）、舌根（T）和会厌（E）水平的阻塞，以及腭后区（RP）与舌后区（RG）水平的阻塞。结果：AST模型显著优于ResNet-50（经Bonferroni校正后P<0.05），能够有效识别V、O和RP水平的阻塞（F1分数：0.59-0.87，马修斯相关系数：0.50-0.80，AUC：0.87-0.97）。然而，由于样本量较小，即使使用了合成少数类过采样技术，两种模型在T、E和RG水平的性能仍然有限。
tldr: 本研究利用音频频谱图Transformer（AST）模型，仅通过鼾声即可有效定位阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停患者软腭、口咽及腭后区水平的上气道塌陷部位，为无创诊断提供了新途径。
